name: Kagamigawa Chloe
source: The older sister of [url=/c64617]Kagamigawa Noelle[/url] and an acquaintance of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. She used to attend Aomine University before dropping out to study in France; she lives with her grandparents there. She adores her little sister to the point of being obsessive at times, sending text messages often and hungry to keep tabs. She worries about Noelle's situation in school and is optimistically cautious about [url=/c64629]Kasane's[/url] entrance into Noelle's life. [spoiler] Her fiancé is [url=/c13500] Tsukamoto Shio[/url]. [/spoiler]
